t: The Mali Empire was a Mandinka state founded by Sundiata Keita that dominated West Africa from the 13th century.
Its gold from Bambuk and Bure fed trans-Saharan trade and made Timbuktu and Djenné centres of commerce and Islamic learning.
Succession disputes, Tuareg and Songhai attacks and shifting trade routes shrank it to its Manding heartland by the 1600s.
dyk: Mansa Musa spent so much gold in Cairo on his 1324 pilgrimage that it was remembered for years, and Mali soon appeared on the Catalan Atlas of 1375.
ev: Sundiata Keita defeats Sumanguru Kanté of Sosso at the Battle of Kirina
